correctness.rationale: The domain is exactly the 81 ternary four-tuples with unordered distinct-column families. Independent coordinatewise symbol permutations justify normalization at 0000. Exhaustive branch-and-bound rules out normalized size ten and enumerates exactly eight normalized size-nine families. Every enumerated family is directly rechecked against every triple and every coordinate pair. The OA-to-PHF converse follows because two OA columns agree in at most one coordinate, while a nonseparated triple across four coordinates would force one of its three pairs to agree twice. Exhausting all 31,104 natural symmetries produces 72 distinct equality cases and exactly the eight normalized cases; orbit-stabilizer gives 432. The verifier is deterministic and finite; no infinite or untested extrapolation is claimed.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete equality classification at the smallest ternary four-row strength-three parameter where the classical MOLS construction reaches nine columns. It upgrades a known construction/table entry to a rigid structure theorem at equality: every optimum is an orthogonal array, with a complete labeled census and symmetry type. That rigidity is useful for recognizing canonical extremizers and for constructions that use small perfect hash families as ingredients; it is not merely a renamed known table value.
